entities.name: Francisco-Javier Lozano Sebastián
entities.label: Person
entities.summary: Francisco-Javier Lozano Sebastián is a Spanish prelate of the Catholic Church who has spent his career in the diplomatic service of the Holy See. He has been an archbishop since 1994 and held the title of Apostolic Nuncio to several countries until his resignation in 2015.
